key_insight: QUANTA combines specialized AI agents with validated instrument control to autonomously plan, evaluate and adapt quantum-materials measurements.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a path toward automating expertise-intensive materials characterization while retaining deterministic checks on instrument actions.
method: Retrieve scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements to inform decisions.
Coordinate specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting and data interpretation.
Validate instrument actions through a deterministic control layer and revise measurements using incoming data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations on a Physical Property Measurement System involving transport measurements of TaP and nonlinear responses in Co2MnGa, but provides no quantitative performance benchmarks.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the demonstrated materials and instrument platform requires further validation of measurement reliability and control safeguards.
paper_title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
